title: Adding an in-product email storage cleanup
summary: Payables Agent app now includes an email storage cleanup solution to help administrators identify and remove duplicate email records, accessible through an in-product interface.
key_points: Adds new codeunits and tables to manage email storage cleanup operations
Introduces setup configuration and duplicate detection buffer for cleanup tasks
Provides pages for administrators to view and manage email duplicates and cleanup settings
Includes a scheduler to run cleanup proactively
Updates permission sets to grant access to cleanup functionality
quote: Adding an in-product solution (accesible only via URL parameter), to proactively send to admins steps for remediation.
